messages:
Samir V: Hey finance — ended up paying for a mandatory UK entry PCR at the airport yesterday because my corpcard was blocked for foreign transactions. Paid on personal card: £85 (converted on statement as USD 112.34). Corpcard later shows a charge and a pending hold; looks like the vendor charged twice. I uploaded the PDF receipt to Concur and attached a photo of the test kit label. Can I get reimbursed and can finance investigate the duplicate?

Finance Bot: Automated: please confirm manager approval and attach the receipt. Policy note: "entry/immigration tests required by destination or client are reimbursable when pre-approved or documented as mandatory." See: https://intra.redwood/expenses#health-entry-tests :information_source:

Samir V: Receipt snippet: 
``
RapidTest UK Ltd.
Service: PCR - Travel Entry
Amount: GBP 85.00 (USD 112.34)
Date: 2026-03-21
Ref: RT-UK-443221
```
Account for reimbursement: Chase ending 7543. Corpcard statement shows `CC-TXN-7012` and a pending hold `CC-HOLD-7012`. I think vendor processed both.

Zoe H: Approved 44d — client required this for the on-site demo, so reimburse Samir.

Finance Bot: Next steps: submit Concur claim under category `Travel - Health/Entry Test`, attach manager approval screenshot or forward this thread, select ACH to last4 7543. Processing ETA: 2 payroll cycles.

Elena R: Logging exception EX-2026-021 and opening a chargeback (ticket CB-102) for the corpcard duplicate. Samir: please confirm project code and whether the test was strictly required by the client or government.

Samir V: Charge to project `CS-EU-04` (client: Norholt). Test was required by venue security for entry to client site (they provided written notice). I've uploaded the notice in Concur.

People Ops: Noted — we'll add a short clause to the travel policy clarifying reimbursable entry tests where venue/client requires testing at time of travel. Add Zoe's approval to the exception log. :pencil2:

Finance Bot: Reimbursement queued (queue id: RQ-7890). Chargeback CB-102 opened. Will post updates when ACH sent or chargeback resolves.

Elena R: I have the attachments. Processing reimbursement now; will update when ACH posts. If chargeback needs more merchant proof I'll reach out. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
